source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade / Downgrade BIOS firmware by Web when system is off
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade BIOS firmware through web UI.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: browser/automation to drive the BMC web-UI flash page + BIOS image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: DeepSeek proposes placing the user-provided BIOS image, driving the BMC WebUI upload/start/wait flow while the host is off, and verifying BIOS version afterward.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Screenshots, flash-completion status and BIOS version before/after, with an asserted clean single reset.
deepseek_columns.risk: DeepSeek identifies the interruptible BIOS-write and brick risk.

original_test_intent: Have an engineer exercise approved BIOS upgrade and downgrade through the BMC WebUI while the host begins powered off, then prove that each selected target BIOS activates and that the platform reaches the project-defined post-update health state.
original_method: The Master method is an attended BMC WebUI BIOS update. Its linked raw-IPMI repository is only a possible read-only version check and is not the flash mechanism or sufficient proof of WebUI behavior, BIOS regions, settings preservation, POST, or boot health.
manual_activity: Under ED-25, a qualified engineer operates the BMC WebUI: chooses the direction-specific signed BIOS image, confirms the destructive update, observes progress and terminal status, and handles any activation prompt. The agent may prepare inputs and analyze supplied evidence but does not click the flash controls or claim the visible result.
required_inputs: platform/board identity plus current, upgrade and downgrade BIOS versions
signed BIOS images with hashes, release notes and supported transition order
vendor WebUI BIOS-update, region/preservation and activation instructions
host-off versus BMC-standby state and any approved reset/power sequence
expected BIOS version, settings, POST/OS health and log criteria
known-good recovery image, flashback path, serial console/OOB and stable power
safety_requirements: Verify board/platform compatibility, image signature/hash, direction and affected BIOS regions before the engineer selects a file; filename similarity is insufficient.
Interpret system off as host-off with the required BMC standby and stable update power, not as automatic AC removal.
Do not assume an upload-complete banner means the BIOS is active; follow the approved activation sequence and independently verify version, settings, POST and boot health.

On timeout, browser loss, update error or uncertain activation, preserve the first evidence and do not upload again, reverse direction, reset or power-cycle without a new engineer decision and recovery plan.
Do not clear pre-existing SEL, kernel or system logs merely to create the requested baseline; capture bounded before/after evidence instead.
agent_execution_scope: Before the engineer-owned WebUI step, organize image identity and transition approval and collect read-only platform, BIOS, BMC, power-state, settings and health baselines.
After the engineer completes the approved WebUI action, collect independent BIOS version, activation timeline, settings, POST/OS, kernel, BMC/SEL and management-health evidence.
Validate the linked raw-IPMI script's command and OEM field mapping for this platform before treating its output as BIOS-version evidence.
Report evidence and gaps without operating the WebUI core, retrying the update or assigning PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
engineer_actions: Approve the image/version order, WebUI path, activation/power behavior, affected regions, settings contract and recovery for each direction.
Operate and observe the WebUI transaction, authorize any reset/power action, and issue separate verdicts for the upgrade and downgrade evidence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The proposed lifecycle keeps host-off, image upload and post-version checking, but unqualified browser automation violates the engineer-operated WebUI boundary and its clean-single-reset claim is not present in this row.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the project-approved BMC WebUI as the attended source method. Use the linked raw-IPMI check only after its platform-specific response decoding is verified, and corroborate it with an authoritative BIOS inventory path.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The WebUI method, initial system-off state, BIOS upgrade/downgrade scope, linked script, successful-flash criterion and 5/30-minute planning values remain source evidence; no reset count is invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: ATTENDED BIOS WEBUI UPDATE WITH DIRECTION-SPECIFIC ACCEPTANCE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: For each approved direction, bind one signed image to the exact platform and intended regions, have the engineer complete the vendor WebUI transaction, perform only the approved activation/power sequence, and independently verify active BIOS, required settings, POST/OS health and logs.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Only platforms whose identified BMC WebUI and BIOS release procedure support the selected off-state update path.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record board SKU, current/target BIOS, BMC/WebUI, browser, raw-IPMI decoder and recovery-tool revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project-approved vendor BIOS-over-BMC WebUI update, activation, region-preservation and recovery documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Preserves the original WebUI action while adding explicit image-to-platform binding, activation, configuration, boot and recovery checkpoints.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A Project SPEC-approved BMC Flash, Redfish or vendor-tool alternative may demonstrate the named BIOS transition, but it does not validate this source WebUI method and cannot prove every BIOS region solely from a version string.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved version/image/region matrix, activation plan, acceptance criteria and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The BMC may report upload completion before host activation; a matching BIOS version does not by itself establish region integrity, preserved settings or successful boot.

project_override_considerations: Project SPEC may authorize another BIOS update tool, but the record must retain the original WebUI method, actual tool, substitution reason, engineer approval, checkpoint equivalence and remaining unverified WebUI coverage. Missing images, versions or parameters are readiness inputs and do not justify permanent BLOCKED.
expected_evidence: approved platform, BIOS version-direction and region matrix with image signatures/hashes
host-off/BMC-standby and stable-power baseline plus required BIOS settings inventory
engineer-owned WebUI evidence for selected image, direction, confirmation, progress, terminal status and errors
approved activation/reset/power timeline without an invented reset count
authoritative post-activation BIOS version plus validated raw-IPMI output if used
post-update settings, POST/console, OS/kernel, BMC/SEL and management-health evidence
recovery readiness and separate engineer verdict for each executed direction

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently identify BIOS upgrade/downgrade through the BMC WebUI from a host-off state. Exact versions, regions, activation behavior and expanded success values are Project SPEC inputs; DeepSeek's clean-single-reset statement is an overlay addition and is not imported into the Master intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The BIOS target, two transition directions, source interface and high-level success objective are understandable. Image/version, region, activation, expected-value and recovery details are identifiable execution-readiness inputs under ED-36 rather than an irreducible semantic conflict.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes PARTIAL to MANUAL ONLY because ED-25 keeps destructive WebUI selection, confirmation and visible acceptance engineer-owned; retains its image prerequisite and interruption warning while rejecting unsupported browser ownership and reset wording.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Preserves the critical BIOS compatibility, settings, POST and recovery safeguards but changes permanent BLOCKED because Project SPEC can supply each missing execution contract without changing the test purpose.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Does not rely on the archived draft's conclusion; independently distinguishes BIOS activation and region coverage from the neighboring BMC self-update case.

review_improvement: Separates BMC WebUI transaction evidence from actual BIOS activation and bootability, prevents a raw version response from standing in for region/settings/POST coverage, and preserves alternative-tool coverage differences.
independent_technical_reasoning: A host can begin off while the BMC remains powered to stage a BIOS image, but the BIOS may not become active until a vendor-defined reset or power transition. That makes browser completion, active-version evidence and platform boot health three distinct checkpoints. The update purpose is clear once a project binds images and acceptance values, so permanent BLOCKED is inappropriate; the source WebUI core remains MANUAL ONLY because ED-25 assigns its operation and visible acceptance to an engineer.
